title: Record Feishu approval decision
description: Records an authenticated approval decision only when expected_candidate_revision equals the authoritative current revision. A stale revision returns 409 CONTENT_VERSION_MISMATCH without mutation. APPROVE authorizes validation to continue; it does not activate content and cannot write to a world.
x-invariants: tenant_id + approval_instance_id identifies one immutable canonical business decision
an identical canonical business decision returns its original receipt without incrementing candidate_revision
a conflicting canonical business decision returns CONTENT_VERSION_MISMATCH without mutation
WORKFLOW_CLOSED forbids decisions from later approval instances for the same candidate
